content.comment_body: How can I adjust the weekly timer setting in the [product_name] App?
This is a known issue. The timer values for on/off periods use BCD coding. You need to choose the HEX data type.
Thank you for clarifying. How do I set up a network variable as HEX and link it to the weekly timer in [product_name] programming software? Can you provide an example please?

You cannot create a HEX variable in the [product_name]. If you configure the tag for the on or off times of the weekly timer in the app, make sure to use the HEX data format. Timer switch settings can be updated in the app by transferring data to the VM section. I can offer a program example for the software page but not for the app page, as I do not have access to the app. Within the [product_name] software, access Tools > Parameter VM Mapping to find the configuration table for VM. For app instructions, refer to the manual (see [document]).
Thank you again for your response and helpful support.

analysis.insight_summary: Users struggled to change weekly timer values in the [product_name] App because on/off times use BCD code and must be set in HEX format in the app. There was confusion about setting and linking variables between the software and app, and it was clarified that HEX variables can't directly be created in the [product_name]—only tags in the app can be formatted as HEX. A manual was referenced for more help, showing there is a lack of clear, built-in guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a user-friendly way to modify timer values in the app, as well as clear instructions for configuring variable data types between [product_name] programming software and app.
